svg.title: Retirement insurance map: keep, cut, or replace
svg.desc: At retirement, term life may expire or convert, disability income usually ends with work, travel medical becomes the trip cover provincial plans do not provide, the home policy needs a downsizing and vacancy check, and group health often ends at retirement or at 65.
svg.text: One page, updated every year you are retired
Assuris death benefit: greater of $1,000,000 or 90% at a member insurer. Page used 24 Sep 2026.
Life: keep, convert, or let term end
Travel medical: buy for the trip
There is no standard retiree long-term disability plan to assume.
Provincial health plans pay a thin daily amount abroad. A credit-card certificate is a document you read, not a reason to skip a policy.
A furnished house you will return to, and an empty house listed for sale, are different occupancy words. Tell the insurer.
Grandchildren who drive the car belong on the driver list. A conversion deadline is a date in the life contract, not a guess.
